summary.text: Kuppa said that AI must be embedded into workflows while ensuring human oversight of AI output. She described AI as a transformative technology that holds tremendous power. In the DOL 2025 AI compliance plan, she described drafting AI procurement contract language, requiring security review before AI tools are authorized, and incorporating responsible AI language into IT contracts and interagency agreements. The plan also described CAIO use-case reviews, audits, a process to discontinue use cases when compliance is unattainable, and stated that DOL has advocated against using public GenAI tools due to information-exposure risk.
